options.name: api_host
options.description: The URL to the Datadog API. Default value is V(https://api.datadoghq.com). This value can also be set with the E(DATADOG_HOST) environment variable.

options.name: api_key
options.description: Your Datadog API key.

options.name: app_key
options.description: Your Datadog app key.

options.name: escalation_message
options.description: A message to include with a re-notification. Supports the '@username' notification we allow elsewhere. Not applicable if O(renotify_interval=none).

options.name: evaluation_delay
options.description: Time to delay evaluation (in seconds). Effective for sparse values.

options.name: id
options.description: The ID of the alert. If set, it is used instead of O(name) to locate the alert.

options.name: include_tags
options.description: Whether notifications from this monitor automatically inserts its triggering tags into the title.

options.name: locked
options.description: Whether changes to this monitor should be restricted to the creator or admins.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the alert.

options.name: new_host_delay
options.description: A positive integer representing the number of seconds to wait before evaluating the monitor for new hosts. This gives the host time to fully initialize.

options.name: no_data_timeframe
options.description: The number of minutes before a monitor notifies when data stops reporting. Must be at least 2x the monitor timeframe for metric alerts or 2 minutes for service checks. If not specified, it defaults to 2x timeframe for metric, 2 minutes for service.

options.name: notification_message
options.description: A message to include with notifications for this monitor. Email notifications can be sent to specific users by using the same '@username' notation as events. Monitor message template variables can be accessed by using double square brackets, in other words C([[) and C(]]).

options.name: notification_preset_name
options.description: Toggles the display of additional content sent in the monitor notification.

options.name: notify_audit
options.description: Whether tagged users are notified on changes to this monitor.

options.name: notify_no_data
options.description: Whether this monitor notifies when data stops reporting.

options.name: priority
options.description: Integer from V(1) (high) to V(5) (low) indicating alert severity.

options.name: query
options.description: The monitor query to notify on. Syntax varies depending on what type of monitor you are creating.

options.name: renotify_interval
options.description: The number of minutes after the last notification before a monitor re-notifies on the current status. It only re-notifies if it is not resolved.

options.name: renotify_occurrences
options.description: The number of times re-notification messages should be sent on the current status at the provided re-notification interval.

options.name: renotify_statuses
options.description: The types of monitor statuses for which re-notification messages are sent.

options.name: require_full_window
options.description: Whether this monitor needs a full window of data before it gets evaluated. We highly recommend you set this to V(false) for sparse metrics, otherwise some evaluations are skipped.

options.name: silenced
options.description: Dictionary of scopes to silence, with timestamps or None. Each scope is muted until the given POSIX timestamp or forever if the value is V(None).

options.name: state
options.description: The designated state of the monitor. The values V(mute) and V(unmute) are deprecated since community.general 13.0.0 and will be removed in 15.0.0. Use the M(community.general.datadog_downtime) module to manage monitor downtimes instead.

options.name: tags
options.description: A list of tags to associate with your monitor when creating or updating. This can help you categorize and filter monitors.

options.name: thresholds
options.description: A dictionary of thresholds by status. Only available for service checks and metric alerts. Because each of them can have multiple thresholds, we do not define them directly in the query. If not specified, it defaults to: V({'ok': 1, 'critical': 1, 'warning': 1}).

options.name: timeout_h
options.description: The number of hours of the monitor not reporting data before it automatically resolves from a triggered state.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of the monitor. The types V(query alert), V(trace-analytics alert) and V(rum alert) were added in community.general 2.1.0. The type V(composite) was added in community.general 3.4.0. The type V(event-v2 alert) was added in community.general 4.8.0.
